cd /workspace/tmp && timeout 175 python3 stress7.py; echo "---- again with fewer packets ----"; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,resource,time
SUB="/workspace/submission/main.py"
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=json.dumps(
 {"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,
  "rules":[{"id":0,"class":1,"priority":5,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]*31+[[0,0]]}]+
          [{"id":i,"class":2,"priority":1,"ranges":[[0,0]]} for i in range(1,2048)],
  "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}}}).encode(),
 stdout=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=60)
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); path=os.path.join(d,"p.json"); open(path,"w").write(json.dumps(json.loads(p.stdout)))
reqs=[]; t=0
for f in range(4096): reqs.append({"op":"open","flow":f,"time":0})
per=1000000//4096
for f in range(4096):
    sent=0
    while sent<per:
        ch=[]
        for _ in range(min(1024,per-sent)):
            t+=1; ch.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":t%2,"length":1+((t*7919)%2048)}); sent+=1
        reqs.append({"op":"chunk","packets":ch})
data="".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
def pre(): resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(512*1024*1024,)*2)
t0=time.time()
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                 stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=120,preexec_fn=pre)
print("%.2fs rc=%d rss=%dMB"%(time.time()-t0,r.returncode,resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss//1024))
print("stderr",r.stderr[:300])
EOF
